kernel.governing_law: Four angels held in reserve are released at a pre-appointed composite moment to emit destruction outward through mounted forces whose mouths discharge plagues that deduct a fixed fraction of humanity.
kernel.mutated_relation: In the transformed world the four are not released outward but spent inward: the angels ARE the cost already paid, the mounts ARE the debt that carries its riders rather than being carried, the mouths do not emit destruction but absorb it — the one-third deducted is subtracted FROM the destroying forces, not from humanity, so that precision of timing names what the utterance has already forfeited to exist.

clause_map.note: Release reverses: four are spent not freed; timing is price, not trigger
Hearing a count is invariant — witness registers magnitude without directing it
Emission reverses: mouths absorb; riders borne-by-debt; simile-of-lions now cost-face
Passive killing reverses patient: one-third deducted from emitters, not from humanity

independent.recovered_law: In TEXT A, destructive substances (fire, smoke, brimstone) flow outward from the mouths of the creatures to kill humans; in TEXT B, the substances (flame, mist, sacrificial smoke) flow inward into the mouths of the creatures, and the agents themselves are consumed/diminished rather than unleashing destruction outward.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same core inversion: destructive forces that originally flow outward from mouths to kill are reversed to flow inward, and the agents/forces themselves are consumed/diminished rather than destroying humanity outward.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion (9:18) maintains the reversed direction: substances flow inward (εἰσρεούσης εἰς τὰ στόματα) and the entities are diminished (ἠλαττώθη), consistent with TEXT B's changed relation throughout.

artifacts.commentary: Every mount here is already laden before it is ridden, every mouth draws inward what would have poured out, every angel names an expenditure already settled — so that the precision of hour and day and month and year marks not the moment of unleashing but the forfeit the utterance has already buried in its own calendar to reach the ear at all.
